theorem mvcc.slots_take2 (Q : IProp GF) (n : Nat) (h : 2 ≤ n) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (),
    Q) ⊢ Q ∗ Q ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (n - 2) (), Q
